scope: 33 pinned OG GitHub source snapshots. Independent Envelope features are distinguished from unresolved gaps. Partial native coverage is not plugin parity.

repositories.distinctive_value: streaming sanitizer, hashline-safe edit anchors and RTK rewrite guards
repositories.extraction_target: streaming sanitizer, hashline-safe edit anchors and RTK rewrite guards
repositories.acceptance_test: Mixed anchored bash output compacts success noise; exact recall of incoming text; source anchors preserved; no duplicate RTK rewriter
repositories.remaining_gap: Streaming sanitizer, hashline-aware read filtering and RTK command rewriting remain Tersio-owned or unimplemented.

repositories.distinctive_value: shape-preserving scrub/elide/dedupe and safety-sensitive YAGNI ladder
repositories.extraction_target: Tool-specific reducers and concise policy exemptions
repositories.acceptance_test: Read/edit/write/errors remain exact; compactor idempotent
repositories.remaining_gap: Multi-host compression and all specialized scrub/elide/deduplication techniques are not ported.

repositories.distinctive_value: branching handoff, repeated-pass stop criteria and chained tasks
repositories.extraction_target: Build bounded summary-based workflow handoffs; require explicit autonomy opt-in
repositories.acceptance_test: Aborts, repeated failures and chained handoffs preserve filesystem
repositories.remaining_gap: Autonomous multi-pass agent branching, chained summarizer and model-selected retries are not implemented.

repositories.distinctive_value: shared RTK/combo/Caveman/Ponytail/pstack/Headroom/timing and host adapters
repositories.extraction_target: Retain sole RTK rewrite owner and integrate settings without shadowing mode state
repositories.acceptance_test: Live Pi, OMP and package entrypoint compatibility smoke tests
repositories.remaining_gap: Pinned dependency manifest exists, but Tersio files and live Pi loader are not installed/tested in this workspace.

repositories.distinctive_value: YAGNI to stdlib to native to existing dependency ladder, with explicit safety valve
repositories.extraction_target: Consolidate into existing Tersio Ponytail policy; no second prompt hook
repositories.acceptance_test: No lost validation/security/accessibility and single policy section
repositories.remaining_gap: Tersio declares Ponytail skills, but this exact fork is not bundled or tested.

repositories.distinctive_value: Python AST function/call relations and reviewer retry loop
repositories.extraction_target: Translate conservative graph nodes into shared code index; no Neo4j requirement
repositories.acceptance_test: Ambiguous calls tagged unresolved; reviewer rejects invented evidence
repositories.remaining_gap: Python class hierarchy, Neo4j, LangGraph reviewer and evidence-based critic loop are not included.

repositories.distinctive_value: Python cross-module inference, inheritance and MRO-aware call classification
repositories.extraction_target: Introduce confidence/evidence field for Python graph importer
repositories.acceptance_test: Builtin/stdlib/project-unresolved/external classifications tested
repositories.remaining_gap: Python MRO, receiver-type inference, builtin/stdlib/external classification and GitHub agent remain absent.

repositories.distinctive_value: pre-write parsing with ERROR/MISSING diagnostics before mutation
repositories.extraction_target: Implement opt-in JS/TS pre-write syntax guard now, multi-language grammar broker later
repositories.acceptance_test: Invalid write/edit blocked; valid edits and uncertain previews pass
repositories.remaining_gap: JS/TS syntax preflight is present; multi-language Tree-sitter pre-write parse and full grammar diagnostics are not.

repositories.distinctive_value: Pi calculus programming-language grammar, unrelated to Pi agent
repositories.extraction_target: Exclude from extension; optional separate language grammar only
repositories.acceptance_test: Cannot register any agent hook; no name-based accidental dependency
repositories.remaining_gap: This is a Pi-calculus language grammar, not a Pi coding-agent extension; deliberately not included.

repositories.distinctive_value: nine-language AST captures, S-expression queries and import/call/inheritance JSON graphs
repositories.extraction_target: v0.11: optional WASM S-expression queries and named capture presets via the shared index; full graph generation remains pending
repositories.acceptance_test: Query S-expressions and named captures through local grammar assets; no extra Pi hooks; stable limits and project paths; real smoke required after installation
repositories.remaining_gap: Query/capture bridge tested with doubles; real WASM assets unavailable and import/call/inheritance graphs not Tree-sitter-generated.

repositories.distinctive_value: Pipe-tree text grammar with source_file literal placeholder, not a functioning Pi agent tool
repositories.extraction_target: Exclude from code runtime until grammar has meaningful rules
repositories.acceptance_test: No project dependency or false grammar capability claims
repositories.remaining_gap: The placeholder Pipe language grammar is unrelated to the Pi coding-agent runtime.

repositories.distinctive_value: Rust N-API hybrid BM25/embeddings and per-branch indexed call graph
repositories.extraction_target: Optional OCI service readiness/query adapter with lexical fallback
repositories.acceptance_test: No native binary -> core works; branch identity preserved
repositories.remaining_gap: Rust native parser, persistent hybrid/vector index, branch catalogs and the external OCI adapter are not ported.

repositories.distinctive_value: MCP sidecar conditional on .codegraph and external CLI, lifecycle probes
repositories.extraction_target: Lazy MCP supervisor with no forced codegraph process
repositories.acceptance_test: Missing index/bin no-op; process cleanup and namespaced tools
repositories.remaining_gap: External codegraph MCP supervisor/index/CLI is deliberately not installed or launched.

repositories.distinctive_value: diagnostic verification confidence and atomic LSP rename/format operations
repositories.extraction_target: v0.9.0: native stdio LSP diagnostic broker and strict transaction-checked symbol rename; full server manager and formatting still pending
repositories.acceptance_test: Verified vs UNVERIFIED LSP reports, no writes on invalid WorkspaceEdit, exact fingerprint-gated preview, ordinary-failure multi-file rollback
repositories.remaining_gap: Full grammar graph, formatter, LSP lifecycle manager, trusted production TS LSP and crash-atomic rename are not delivered.

repositories.distinctive_value: incremental content-hash parse caching, PageRank and bounded ranked symbol map
repositories.extraction_target: Incremental AST map invalidation and replace-not-append prompt injection
repositories.acceptance_test: Single file edit reparses one file; deterministic map within budget
repositories.remaining_gap: Hash-aware per-file reuse/PageRank overview exist; full WASM query mapping, three budgeted map tiers and prompt injection replacement do not.

repositories.distinctive_value: PR-head SHA evidence binding, import-graph blast radius and docs/code contradictions
repositories.extraction_target: Build commit-pinned review evidence and test-neighbor retrieval
repositories.acceptance_test: Line citations actually match PR head; stale head rejects
repositories.remaining_gap: Commit-pinned changed-line/test candidate evidence exists; hosted GitHub PR agent, embeddings, reviews, persistence and interview mode do not.

repositories.distinctive_value: legacy Pi bash/user command RTK rewriting semantics; archive moved to pi-extensions
repositories.extraction_target: Compare modern monorepo semantics, retain Tersio sole rewriter
repositories.acceptance_test: Single vs double bang; no rewrite of existing rtk commands
repositories.remaining_gap: Archived RTK fork is not installed; Tersio owns RTK command rewriting.

repositories.distinctive_value: tool-aware test/build/linter/git reductions and per-technique stats
repositories.extraction_target: Add cross-fixture compression precision tests, do not install second filter
repositories.acceptance_test: Pass/fail and lint diagnostic details preserved; savings measured
repositories.remaining_gap: Conservative bash reduction exists; complete technique suite and separate rtk_configure are intentionally absent.

repositories.distinctive_value: OMP settings compatibility with granular Caveman intensities
repositories.extraction_target: Carry host capability tests into Tersio mode adapter
repositories.acceptance_test: Missing OMP settings keys preserve off/default semantics
repositories.remaining_gap: OMP settings-specific fork is not installed; Tersio supplies native Pi Caveman modes when available.

repositories.distinctive_value: Cavecrew subagent prompts and ordered before_agent_start composition
repositories.extraction_target: Optional role presets through native workflow; single prompt composer
repositories.acceptance_test: No duplicate command registration; reviewer role bounded
repositories.remaining_gap: Tersio-style guidance is declared but Cavecrew subagents, commands and this exact fork are not ported.

repositories.distinctive_value: voice-only answer-first, exact preservation of code, commands, paths, negations
repositories.extraction_target: Improve safe concise policy invariants and prompt snapshots
repositories.acceptance_test: Security qualifications, exit codes and negation untouched
repositories.remaining_gap: Output-style preservation remains Tersio-owned; independent fork not installed.

repositories.distinctive_value: local isolated tool output, chunked FTS/BM25+RRF search and fail-open sandbox hooks
repositories.extraction_target: Chunked retrieval on existing raw store; optional sandbox adapter
repositories.acceptance_test: Project isolation, WAL recovery, bounded retrieval, exact original retained
repositories.remaining_gap: v0.15.0 adds locally indexed bounded chunk FTS5/BM25 plus lexical RRF, verified recall, and incremental migration. Sandbox execution, embeddings and comprehensive Context Mode parity are not ported.

repositories.distinctive_value: named checkpoint, timeline, reversible checkpoint compaction
repositories.extraction_target: Existing Envelope context coordinator; add native session-tree projection validity checks
repositories.acceptance_test: Branch switching and checkpoint anchor cannot silently prune wrong branch
repositories.remaining_gap: Session checkpoint/timeline/restore supported; source project's agentic summarization and selection policy are not ported.

repositories.distinctive_value: versioned hierarchical ACP block contract and replayable sidecars
repositories.extraction_target: Versioned block schema + re-expand recovery under sole context owner
repositories.acceptance_test: Roundtrip, corrupt sidecar rollback, exactly one context transformer
repositories.remaining_gap: v0.14.0 adds checkpoint-parented versioned exact-replay blocks and transaction recovery, not full multi-generation ACP summaries or independent ACP agents.

repositories.distinctive_value: cache-aware batch frontier and append-only evidence retrievability
repositories.extraction_target: Durable prune frontier with agent-message default, not every-turn churn
repositories.acceptance_test: Crash reconstruction, no repeated summarization, cache-cost evidence
repositories.remaining_gap: v0.14.0 adds atomic per-checkpoint block batches and restart replay; no LLM summarization calls, provider cache-causal proof, or autonomous frontier heuristics.

repositories.distinctive_value: milestone/slice/task hierarchy, verification evidence, worktree isolation and recovery
repositories.extraction_target: Existing native task DAG and worktree handoffs; add milestone projections and auto-stop gates
repositories.acceptance_test: Lease expiry/retry/dirty worktree/review approval tracked
repositories.remaining_gap: Task DAG, detached worktrees, review evidence exist; milestone/slice planner, autonomous loops and host distribution are absent.

repositories.distinctive_value: durable team ownership, messaging, Pi RPC runner and activity relay
repositories.extraction_target: Keep built-in workflow ledger; optional RigSpec/message relay
repositories.acceptance_test: No daemon required; never inherit approval bypass
repositories.remaining_gap: OpenRig RigSpec/message bus/tmux daemon are not ported; optional bridge would need explicit consent.

repositories.distinctive_value: read-only prompt/section/tool-definition injection visibility
repositories.extraction_target: Namespaced context footprint inspector and zero-injection dashboard
repositories.acceptance_test: Inspections do not mutate requests; secrets redacted
repositories.remaining_gap: Read-only prompt byte categories exist; interactive injected-section viewer and exact host tokenizer costs are not.

repositories.distinctive_value: cross-agent transcript BM25/hybrid search and bounded session retrieval
repositories.extraction_target: Opt-in Memex search adapter, no transcript export by default
repositories.acceptance_test: Consent, provenance, scope and bounded results
repositories.remaining_gap: Cross-agent transcript extraction, indexing, embeddings, session resume and Memex MCP are not installed.

repositories.distinctive_value: append/replace/strict prompt surgery with exact-text guard
repositories.extraction_target: Diagnostics-only strict mode opt-in; compose named sections conservatively
repositories.acceptance_test: Unknown upstream prompt wording causes no-op, not silent deletion
repositories.remaining_gap: Strict destructive prompt surgery is intentionally excluded; only conservative opt-in policy append exists.

repositories.distinctive_value: real Pi package install/link verification and duplicate resource diagnostics
repositories.extraction_target: Add package doctor, dependency graph and collision report
repositories.acceptance_test: Detect global+local duplicate paths; missing dependency flags
repositories.remaining_gap: RPC rejects duplicate command registrations, but global/project package inventory and Git widget are not implemented.

repositories.distinctive_value: risk-aware clarity override and persisted intensity state
repositories.extraction_target: Ensure terse policy yields on security/irreversible work
repositories.acceptance_test: Safety warning never suppressed, resumed mode precedence
repositories.remaining_gap: Tersio declares Caveman; no separate fork, and live mode coexistence is unverified.

repositories.distinctive_value: minimal style-only Pi extension and off switch
repositories.extraction_target: Use as regression sample for clean off and technical term preservation
repositories.acceptance_test: Off creates no prompt delta; commands/code preserved verbatim
repositories.remaining_gap: Caveman duplicate intentionally not installed; style invariants remain comparative fixtures only.

coverage_vocabulary.native-partial: Tested Envelope behavior adapts a subset; upstream implementation is not fully ported
coverage_vocabulary.dependency-unverified: Capability declared through Tersio dependency, which was not live-loaded locally
coverage_vocabulary.optional-external: External application deliberately separate; adapter not installed or live tested
coverage_vocabulary.compared-only: Design/test reference only; no direct source inclusion
coverage_vocabulary.excluded: Unrelated, redundant or unsafe competing subsystem deliberately excluded
